book.name: Qayeeng yeip yaing
book.title: Kilisi talex qayeeng xupekeing yeip yaing wou Yoan

content: Siaking wei toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu yo

Ka tine la veil, a xei qapomb ti tax me toungale eivek tyoung gheyapu wou a mang. Me vya wei a ngo natax o luk wou ay nambei vukxax eno neil, “Lam gheyapu ne, tyek a talex wou wang en vati wei embei nam yus en tine yo.”
Lutika eno Laweeng Vambuing lam nale eivek ay, me a xei siaking ti toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu is xelti eno toundei lek.
Me tiwei toundei lek nanghei inyon xok ambei qakous lei jaspa is qakous gyand lei kanilian. Myeiy liw on ti teyei lek qakous neluy nambei emeral, di vivekwou siaking.
24 siaking bamba dei vivekwou siaking, me 24 teivateiv toundei lek siaking. Xel vunek en teimb teleing me toung qelumking wei ghol eno lek lund.
Zivip nex mema lam eivek siaking, me wong nindenduing ngandoung de dewek toung ngandoung. Lam nenyex lim yuw wei di tum magyand eno toungale wou siaking. Xel tine inye laweeng lim yuw wei Anutu yo.

Me toungale wou siaking nanghei inyon is eno xok ambei mamileeng wei dewek o, me inyei wo mabelin. Eivek masenghoing e vivekwou siaking eno lul mapieing vey, me xel mend ngenong eno sevunexe xel, wou manghalus me wou demi.
Lul mapieing tiwei tax o nambei layon, de nge wei yuw eno nambei manghaxo, me nge wei yal eno ma ne nambei xomaxoneing ti, de tiwei vey eno nambei tuw wei mi zeivek o.

Lul mapieing vey on titi eno banis teyei lek limti me manghalus ngenong sevunexe e vivekwou dalus, me eivek e banis xeinghembi. Me bendiyeing aluw boukeing eno xel se mi tip neileing. “Vambuing, vambuing, vambuing, inyei Tambiy Ngandoung Anutu Nikanzekta, wei takwei, me gweimbeeng de ingwei tyek mendi nam o.”
De lek bouk kawei lul mapieing bong xeiyaing ngandoung me bong e lei zekna me bo dange na wou e wei mindei lek siaking me mindei luta luta yo,
24 teivateiv ev vaxend qatu eivek wou e wei mindei lek siaking o manghalus, me wo lalo wou e wei mindei mapieing luta luta yo. Xel liw xel xe qelumking ghol wou siaking me neil.

content.text: “Wang on teyei lek, xa xe Tambiy Ngandoung me Anutu,
bei na qou xeiyaing ngandoung me bong e lei zekna me nikanzek ngandoung,
en wang toung lulul sapa yon,
me nangya wa xe woueing nalei eno wang toung lulul on tyip
